mechanics.scope: One dynamic convex cube against three fixed angled slabs and a fixed catcher.
mechanics.contact_model: Proposed convex rigid-body contact; actual contact, gap and replay evidence remain required.
mechanics.material_model: Per-actor coefficients are declared in the companion Markdown card; no coefficient is calibrated or measured here.
mechanics.actuation_model: Gravity and contact determine free body motion; only declared visible latches may be prescribed.
limitations: Historical Native Bullet transfer/convergence calibration failed; this plan neither repairs nor relaxes it.
Current analytic backend cannot validate this dynamic-body scope.

route_stages.entry_intent: Released cube begins free fall toward first slab.
route_stages.exit_intent: Earned outgoing path reaches second slab.

route_stages.entry_intent: Incoming rotating cube approaches second slab.
route_stages.exit_intent: Earned outgoing path reaches third slab.

route_stages.entry_intent: Incoming cube passes intended rail-tip clearance then reaches third slab.

route_stages.exit_intent: Cube remains visibly supported through endpoint.

events.physical_cause: Gravity-driven free fall meets the first fixed angled slab.
events.measurement_required: Independently classify the contact point as broad-face and measure contact onset plus outgoing velocity.

events.physical_cause: The first earned tumble reaches the offset second fixed slab.
events.measurement_required: Independently classify edge-first contact and measure a heading change without transform injection.

events.physical_cause: The preceding gravity/contact trajectory reaches the third fixed slab.
events.measurement_required: Independently classify corner-biased contact; separately certify any pre-contact rail-tip clearance.

camera.framing_intent: One wide three-quarter composition covers all slabs, the pre-contact graze and the catcher.

ending.description: Keep cube fully framed, physically supported and off-axis at the endpoint.

reference_lessons.lesson: Use spatially separated supports and explicit collision geometry; no reference-media claim is made.
reference_lessons.evidence_note: This card consulted repository component/planning documentation, not a viewed reference clip; source bytes are intentionally unbound while concurrent work continues.
